decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation extends the firm's established laser line, and it is still listed on the website, so dropping it would write off development work in a line the firm keeps investing in.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer has had its own page for two years and is central to the core coding portfolio, so the firm has a strong visible commitment to keep it.
The piezo inkjet printer has had its own page for two years and is close to the core offer, which makes its withdrawal unlikely.
The industrial laser systems are featured on the home page and are central to the announced Industry 4.0 direction, so the firm is highly committed to them in public.
The LC400 laser cabin was announced publicly as new in 2024, and any weak early results can still be put down to launch-phase ramp-up.
The award-winning HR-Lube system is publicly recognized, and dropping it so soon would mean writing off a visible, much-praised investment.
